items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And of course Carlos and I later became real great friends. In fact we were in business together for a short time.

ctx.x: And Carlos, that's the first time I met him, he was running a ballroom called the Domar Ballroom, down at one of the beaches, Hermosa or someplace right there, and we had to find a place to play, to try out our new instruments and to find out how much we remembered. He said, 'I'll take the band.' So he put us in there and we went through, and I said, 'Hey, we've got enough. We can go. We don't have to worry about anything.' And of course Carlos and I later became real great friends. In fact we were in business…
